title: Youth Congress protests, suspended Instagram accounts and Meta’s response: What we know so far

ai.summary: The Indian Youth Congress (IYC) has demanded the restoration of suspended Instagram accounts and removal of restrictions after Meta restricted content related to political activities, with protests occurring in Hyderabad, Mumbai and Gurugram since November 20.

facts.claim: IYC members have held demonstrations outside Meta-affiliated offices in Hyderabad, Mumbai and Gurugram
facts.quote: Since November 20, IYC members have held demonstrations outside Meta-affiliated offices in Hyderabad, Mumbai and Gurugram.

facts.claim: Meta restricted content related to political activities
facts.quote: Meta officials told the delegation that the Information Technology (IT) Rules prohibit the posting, uploading, sharing or transmission of certain categories of content on its platforms.

facts.claim: Meta's content restrictions apply to AI-generated content
facts.quote: According to the officials, these restrictions also apply to content created or substantially modified using artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning and other computational tools, including deepfakes and AI-generated text, images, audio and videos.

facts.claim: Meta may restrict access to accounts temporarily or permanently
facts.quote: The company may also temporarily or permanently restrict access to entire accounts on the same grounds.

ai.background_note: The Indian Youth Congress (IYC) has been protesting against Meta's suspension of Instagram accounts since November 20, with demonstrations in Hyderabad, Mumbai and Gurugram.
